processing.rgb: Every visible output RGB copied from original at same pixel coordinates. No face, style, colours, body or tail painted/replaced. Transparent-only RGB zeroed.
processing.semanticMask: ImageGen generated independently for this asset. Whole semantic mask expanded by this asset measured radius to include all original alpha>=250 core; no shared Sakiko mask or coordinate default. Red tail identity expanded 12px, clipped to native contour and actual source rump arc.
processing.nativeAlpha: Original alpha max254. Original alpha multiplied by native-opacity gate 0 at <=230, 1 at >=250, linear between; only original solid ink/colour survives, broad diffuse blue halo exits. Coarse semantic identity remains a guard.
processing.root: Visible tail begins beyond this asset own rump arc. Original navy foreground root ink retained in body, with 4px source-ink-only overlap. Tail contains an 18px original neighbouring RGB hidden underlap from y620 to this asset actual root end, no painted hidden tail.

review.scope: 128px light/dark and both mirror directions; root -5/0/+5 degree static detail. Shape, character face/hair/eyes and colour stay source-original. Body/paws stationary. Fine native antialias remains; no broad blue glow or open seam observed at normal small size.

motionBoundary.mirror: Shared outer wrapper mirrors both layers; retain source-local tail pivot; speech text lives outside mirrored layers.
